_comment: Full-stack job: buildings (Microsoft footprints) + vehicles (YOLO26-OBB) + roads (U-Net). Each process emits a disjoint class set so cross-process double-counting is impossible. Run with: uv run terrascope --config packages/cli/examples/job.full_stack.json

processes._comment: Vector building footprints from Microsoft Global Buildings. No model inference — fetches the pre-extracted shards covering the AOI from Azure CDN, clips to the raster footprint, drops anything under 20 m² (geodesic).
processes.name: msft-buildings

processes._comment: YOLO26 OBB on DOTA v2 classes. Restricted to the four DOTA vehicle/aircraft labels so the output stays focused. Min confidence 0.25 trims weak boxes; SAHI handles tiling automatically when the long side > 1024px.
processes.name: yolo26-obb

processes._comment: U-Net road segmentation. Uses the bundled road_unet.pth checkpoint (resnet34, trained at ~0.054 m/px). Sliding 512-px patches with sigmoid cutoff 0.4; min_area_px=200 kills speckle.
processes.name: unet-roads
